entries.source_evidence: Player's exact spoken reply to official at functioning Crownsunder–western Veyr surface commercial frontier, Day273 late afternoon: 'Passing through the common road to eastwatch'. Officer accepts stated lawful through-transit destination on the maintained commercial road via Caer Veylan; routine professional inspection/log of four travelers and personal traveling baggage is handled without a contested check, new identity assumption, named border paperwork or invented toll. There is no evidenced cause to detain, confiscate, reroute, investigate V's ancestry, demand a new quest, or obstruct the lawful commercial crossing. With existing V authorization to pass through and continue on the public road, officers independently wave the sound four-horse coach into western Veyr; no spell, attack, resource or expenditure. A few ordinary minutes pass, Day273 still late afternoon; no border charge, new magic item, property transfer or Day273 night roll. V's actual utterance is the only V speech; companions may be observant but make no commitments. Current V HP48/48 HD7/7, Second Wind1/1, ActionSurge1/1, Superiority4/4, Psi6/6, MP7/7, purse1137gp7sp6cp; Fenar59/59 HD4/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3; Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full slots, Mara unharmed; rations12 person-days/feed16 animal-days, all four horses healthy, coach intact; Long Rest progress1/6. No fresh Day273 encounter, no arrival in Caer Veylan or Eastwatch. Next V choice: continue on eastern commercial road into Commonwealth or another lawful action.

entries.source_evidence: Player exact instruction after Day273 late-afternoon border entry: "continue". Party V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar continues eastern commercial highway from lawful western Veyr border crossing toward Caer Veylan, Eastwatch, Nightglass; no other V conversation or choices invented. Roads within western Veyr reasonably patrolled, so road tier declared HEAVILY PATROLLED: day01-07, exposed night01-03. Day273 already had its daytime roll48/no event before border; it is NOT rerolled. Night273 exposed roadside camp genuine Python secrets uniform d100 FACE50 vs01-03 NO random occurrence; quiet qualifying wilderness overnight Short Rest with V full HP and standing pre-rest healing priorities not triggered, no HD expended by anyone, no feature use or injury. Weighted Long Rest progress1/6->2/6 at DAWN274 (not full Long Rest). Day274 morning one standard allocation 3 ration-person-days for Mara/Cirren/Fenar and4 horse-feed animal-days for V's four healthy horses: stores rations12->9, feed16->12, no repeated Day273 debit or coin expense. Party continues with intact coach and four owned healthy horses; Day274 daytime ordinary heavily patrolled road genuine Python secrets d100 FACE17 vs01-07 => NO RANDOM encounter. No separate type/severity roll. By late morning Day274, party reaches SECOND ordinary work lay-by EAST of established Crownsunder/western Veyr commercial border along trunk road WEST of Caer Veylan (not yet reached town); north spur marked, two road miles ~one hour by coach to muster, main road open. Eligible PRIVATE prepared event WTR-274 from current prep/dm-only/dm-nightglass-route.md: regular road-cutting reopening shift begins Day274 08:00, crew's planned old end-wall breach actually occurs Day274 10:00 since no intervening weather, delay, or alternative action was established; loaded skip jams across haul route and four adult workers T1-T4 initially alive and mobile in sound rear refuge; T4 bruised ankle without mechanical penalty, two natural cave fishers in annex, breathable refuge/ventilation exits retained. This is an independent event on its fixed clock, NOT a new random encounter nor caused by V's arrival; its cave-fisher/geometry secrets remain DM only. Carter WTR-C hears replies from all four at10:20, departs muster with report at10:30, arrives along trunk lay-by at11:30; actually meets/flags passing V coach, tells party only firsthand known details: four workers trapped behind haul room, answered before departure, blocked haul path, strange sticky line pulling tools into darkness, forewoman knows another way in, muster about one hour up north spur, requests capable help; does NOT know creature names/numbers or current fate. No carter name invented, no V answer, acceptance, rescue movement, reward, equipment transfer, diplomacy, combat, spending or new rolls. The incident is now activated independently and the rescue OPTION is OFFERED, not accepted. Time stops near Day274 11:30 at WTR-C's roadside request. Party HP/resources at fixed prior snapshot unchanged: V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Psi6/6 SecondWind1/1 ActionSurge1/1 Superiority4/4 MP7/7 purse1137gp7sp6cp, Fenar59/59 HD4/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3 Channel2/2, Mara uninjured; LongRest2/6. Supply9 ration-days feed12 animal-days. Four horses/coach healthy and intact. No day274 night roll and no quest development moved to fit the party.
